article.title: AI Agents: Permission Boundaries, Auditability, and Accountability

paragraphs.en: AI agents differ from ordinary chatbots because they can plan and execute actions through connected tools. An agent might search documents, update customer records, schedule operations, or initiate a purchase. Such capabilities can reduce repetitive coordination, but they also introduce risks beyond inaccurate text. An incorrect answer may mislead someone, while an unauthorized action may change a database or transfer money. Organizations must decide which actions an agent may observe, propose, and execute. Autonomy should be granted deliberately, not assumed whenever a language model connects to software. The fundamental governance question is who remains accountable when automated behavior affects people and businesses.
paragraphs.zh: AI代理不同於一般聊天機器人，因為能透過工具規劃及執行操作，例如搜尋文件、更新客戶紀錄、排程或發起採購。這能減少重複協調，也帶來超越文字錯誤的風險。錯誤答案可能誤導，未授權行動可能改資料或轉錢。企業須分別界定可觀察、建議與執行的權限，自主權應審慎授予。根本治理問題是自動行動影響人與企業時由誰負責。
paragraphs.ja: AIエージェントは検索、記録更新、予定設定、購入などの操作を実行できます。便利な一方、誤操作でデータや資金が変わる危険があります。閲覧、提案、実行の権限を分け、責任者を明確にします。

paragraphs.en: The principle of least privilege offers a practical starting point. An agent should receive only the permissions needed for a specific task and only for the necessary period. Reading an invoice is different from approving payment, and drafting an email is different from sending it. These activities should not share authority merely because they appear in one workflow. High-risk actions may require explicit human approval, transaction limits, or separation of duties. Access should be restricted to relevant accounts, datasets, and environments. Broad credentials create unnecessary exposure, particularly when agents encounter unexpected instructions in external content. Operators must be able to inspect and revoke permissions without difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 最小權限是實務起點。代理只應在必要期間取得特定任務所需權限。讀發票不同於核准付款，寫郵件草稿不同於寄送，不應因同流程就共享授權。高風險操作可要求人工核准、交易上限或職責分離。權限應限制相關帳戶、資料集與環境。過廣憑證擴大暴露風險，操作人員必須能方便查看及撤銷權限。
paragraphs.ja: 最小権限では、作業に必要な期間と対象だけアクセスを与えます。請求書閲覧と支払承認、下書きと送信は別です。高リスク操作には人の承認や金額上限を設け、不要な権限を取り消します。

paragraphs.en: Instruction hierarchy matters because agents process untrusted information. A webpage may contain useful facts alongside text demanding that the agent ignore its rules or disclose secrets. Such text is material to analyze, not an authorized instruction. Secure designs separate user-approved tasks from retrieved content and constrain available tool calls. They can validate proposed actions against independent business rules before execution. No single prompt guarantees safety in every situation. Defense in depth combines restricted credentials, structured interfaces, monitoring, and human review. Organizations should test adversarial documents, misleading search results, and conflicting instructions before permitting agents to perform sensitive operations.
paragraphs.zh: 指令層級很重要，因代理會處理不可信資訊。網頁可能同時有事實與要求忽略規則或洩密的文字，後者只是待分析材料，並非授權指令。安全設計應分離核准任務與檢索內容，限制工具呼叫，以獨立業務規則檢查操作。單靠提示詞無法保證安全，須結合限權憑證、結構化介面、監控及人工審查，並測試惡意文件與衝突指令。
paragraphs.ja: 外部ページの指示は正式な権限ではありません。承認済みの作業と検索内容を分け、ツール操作を制限します。権限管理、業務ルールによる検証、監視、人の確認を重ねます。

paragraphs.en: Auditability requires more than preserving a chat transcript. Investigators need to know which agent version acted, which person initiated the request, which data were accessed, which tools were invoked, and which approvals were granted. Logs should include timestamps, identifiers, outcomes, and relevant policy decisions without exposing unnecessary personal information. Records must be protected against unauthorized modification and retained according to applicable requirements. A reproducible audit trail helps explain failures and distinguish a model suggestion from human authorization. When several agents collaborate, their handoffs must also be traceable. Otherwise, responsibility may disappear across a long chain of automated decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 可稽核性不只保留聊天紀錄。調查者需要知道代理版本、發起人、存取資料、工具呼叫及核准。日誌應含時間、識別碼、結果與政策判斷，同時避免多餘個資。紀錄需防未授權修改並依法保存。可重現稽核軌跡能區分模型建議與人工授權。多代理協作時也要追蹤交接，否則責任可能消失在自動決策鏈中。
paragraphs.ja: 監査にはモデル版、依頼者、アクセス先、ツール操作、承認履歴が必要です。記録を保護し、複数エージェントの引き継ぎも追跡します。

paragraphs.en: Human oversight should reflect consequences rather than create the appearance of control. Requiring approval for every trivial step encourages careless clicking. Allowing irreversible financial or legal operations without review creates excessive exposure. A risk-based model distinguishes reversible, low-impact tasks from actions affecting customers, funds, access rights, or regulated decisions. Approval interfaces should display proposed changes, supporting evidence, uncertainty, and expected impact in language reviewers understand. Reviewers must have sufficient time and authority to reject an action. Human involvement is meaningful only when it can influence the outcome, rather than simply rubber-stamping a recommendation made by a machine.
paragraphs.zh: 人工監督應依後果設計，而非表面控制。每個小步都核准容易機械點擊，讓不可逆金融或法律操作免審查又風險過大。風險導向模型區分可逆低影響任務與影響客戶、資金、權限或監管決策的操作。核准畫面須顯示變更、證據、不確定性及預期影響，審查者要有時間與權力拒絕，不能只是形式蓋章。
paragraphs.ja: 人の監督は影響度に応じて設計します。細かな承認の乱発は形骸化し、重大な不可逆操作の無審査は危険です。提案と根拠を示し、担当者が実際に拒否できる仕組みが必要です。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation must examine complete workflows rather than isolated model answers. Tests should check whether an agent respects permission boundaries, handles missing information, asks for clarification, and stops when a tool fails. Scenarios can include conflicting instructions, duplicate requests, delayed responses, and unexpected changes in external systems. Organizations should measure task success alongside unauthorized-action rates, recovery time, review burden, and user trust. A system that completes most tasks quickly may still be unsuitable if rare failures are severe. Teams should define thresholds for pausing operations and prepare rollback procedures for reversible changes. Evaluation must continue as tools, data, and business rules evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 評估須測完整流程，而非單一模型回答。測試應檢查代理守權限、處理缺資訊、主動釐清及工具失敗時停止。情境可含衝突指令、重複請求、延遲與外部系統變更。除成功率外還要量測未授權操作、復原時間、審查負擔及信任。少數嚴重失敗仍可能使系統不適用。應定義暫停門檻與可逆變更的回復程序，並持續評估。
paragraphs.ja: 評価では権限遵守、情報不足時の確認、ツール障害時の停止を検証します。成功率だけでなく不正操作、復旧時間、確認負担を測り、停止基準とロールバックを準備します。

paragraphs.en: Accountability cannot be delegated to a language model. The deploying organization must assign owners for system design, data access, business decisions, incident response, and compliance. Vendors may provide technical components, but internal leaders still decide whether a workflow is appropriate. Contracts can clarify responsibilities between parties without replacing internal governance. Employees need a safe way to report unexpected behavior without fear of retaliation. After an incident, the objective should be to understand which controls failed and prevent recurrence, not merely identify the last person who clicked a button. Clear escalation paths ensure that serious concerns reach someone with authority to act.
paragraphs.zh: 責任不能委派給語言模型。部署組織須指定系統設計、資料存取、業務決策、事故應變與法遵負責人。供應商提供技術元件，內部主管仍決定流程是否適當。合約可釐清責任但不能取代治理。員工要能安全回報異常。事故後應理解控制失效並防再發，而非只找最後按按鈕的人。明確升級管道可讓重大疑慮傳達給有權者。
paragraphs.ja: 責任はモデルに委ねられません。設計、アクセス、業務判断、事故対応、法令順守の担当者を定めます。問題報告の経路を整え、事故後は再発防止を優先します。

paragraphs.en: A sustainable strategy expands autonomy gradually. Begin with read-only assistance, progress to supervised drafts, and permit limited execution only after evidence supports the change. Monitor performance as models, tools, data, and business rules evolve. Review permissions periodically and revoke access that is no longer necessary. This staged approach may seem slower than connecting every tool immediately, but it protects trust and makes failures easier to diagnose. Success should not be measured by how many human clicks disappear. It should be measured by whether useful work becomes more reliable, accountable, and controllable as automation grows. Responsible autonomy is a property of the entire operating system, not the model alone.
paragraphs.zh: 可持續策略應逐步擴大自主權：先唯讀協助，再受監督草稿，證據充分後才有限執行。模型、工具、資料和規則變動時持續監控，定期撤銷不必要權限。分階段雖看似較慢，卻能維持信任、方便診斷失敗。成功不在減少多少人工點擊，而在自動化擴大時工作是否更可靠、可問責且可控制。負責任自主權屬於整體營運系統，而非模型單獨特性。
paragraphs.ja: 自律性は閲覧支援、監督付き草案、限定実行へ段階的に拡大します。権限を見直し、信頼性と説明責任を維持します。自律性はモデルだけでなく運用全体の性質です。

paragraphs.en: Organizations should also plan for changes in personnel and suppliers. A departing employee's access must not remain active through an agent, and a new service provider should not inherit broad permissions by default. Periodic reviews can compare actual tool use with approved business purposes. Clear documentation makes these reviews practical and helps future teams understand why a particular boundary exists. Governance succeeds when controls remain effective during ordinary organizational change, not only during a carefully managed demonstration.
paragraphs.zh: 企業還應考慮人員與供應商更替。離職員工的權限不能透過代理持續有效，新供應商也不應預設繼承廣泛授權。定期審查可比對實際工具使用與核准業務目的。清楚文件有助後續團隊理解權限界線。治理成功在於日常組織變化中控制仍有效，而不只是精心安排的展示。
paragraphs.ja: 人員や取引先の変更時にも権限を見直します。退職者のアクセスを残さず、新しい事業者へ広い権限を自動継承させません。実際の操作と承認済みの目的を定期的に照合します。
